scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I can ^0055FFsign your name^000000 on almost any rare item you hold.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
我几乎可以在您持有的任何稀有物品上^0055FF签下您的名字^000000。

scripts.text: Tell me more...
scripts.translation: 告诉我更多...

scripts.text: Sign my items, please!
scripts.translation: 请给我的物品签名！

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I can put your name on any slotless equipment or weapon.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
我可以在任何没有卡槽的装备或武器上签下您的名字。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
For my work I accept:
 ~ {0}x {1}
 ~ {2} Zeny
 ~ {3} Zeny per refine
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
收费如下：
 ~ {0}x {1}
 ~ {2} Zeny
 ~ 每级精炼加收{3} Zeny

scripts.translation:

我的工作报酬如下：

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I work for free, but...
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
我免费帮忙，不过...

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Alas, I have 12 hungry children
and a very angry wife.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
唉，我还有12个嗷嗷待哺的孩子和一个火气很大的老婆。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Or it was 12 angry children
and a very hungry wife...
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
还是说，是12个火气很大的孩子和一个饿得不行的老婆...

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Show me your items to sign...
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
请给我看看您要签名的物品...

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Nothing is equipped there!
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
那个部位没有穿戴装备！

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Alas, this item's already signed.
I would never touch a master's work.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
唉，这件物品已经有署名了。
我可不会动其他大师的作品。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
A card? Here?!
As I said before, I don't sign items with cards.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
这里竟然有卡片？！
我说过，不给镶嵌了卡片的物品签名。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Sorry, I don't sign slotted items.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
抱歉，我不给有卡槽的物品签名。

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
Sorry, I don't sign rental items!
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
抱歉，我不给租赁物品签名！

scripts.text:

I will need:
 ~ {0}x {1}
 ~ {2} Zeny
Shall I sign your ^0055FF{3}^000000?
scripts.translation:

 ~ {0}x {1}
 ~ {2} Zeny
要在您的^0055FF{3}^000000上签名吗？

scripts.text: Ok!
scripts.translation: 好的！

scripts.text: Leave
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
See you...
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]

scripts.text:
[Perchik]
I don't work for 'thanks'.
scripts.translation:
[佩尔奇克]
光说声“谢谢”可不能当报酬。

scripts.text:

Where is {0}...?
scripts.translation:
